properties.comment: Lake Region Electric will have a planned power outage on Monday, October 26th, beginning at 9 am and will last until approximately 12 noon.  Services affected will be in an area North of 137th Street on 434th Avenue, then 432nd Avenue, East to Hazelden Lake, and South and East to the West Side of Waubay Lake.  Crews will be adding infrastructure to the line during this time.   If you work from home or have a medical condition, we request that you relocate during the outage time, or use backup generation.  If you received a text or email regarding a planned outage for October 23rd, please disregard as the information was incorrect.   Thank you for your patience!
